payments-bot: Alert: charge failed for INV-6001 (EQPay Inc.) - decline code: card_declined. Attempt 1.

claire_finance: Noted. This is a renewal for an enterprise account. I emailed billing contact earlier.

tom_support: Customer replied in ticket: card declined, treasury wants to wire today. Asked for wire instructions.

claire_finance: Ok. Provide wire template and ask them to include INV-6001 in the reference. Pause auto-dunning and auto-cancel for 48h. @mark_accounting please hold notices.

mark_accounting: Pausing dunning 48h and marking invoice as "pending - wire". Will reconcile when we get bank confirmation.

jen_sales: AM says they'll initiate wire if we share details. They may request provisional access once payment is initiated - AM will confirm.

claire_finance: Wire template (mask account digits) - please copy verbatim and ask for payment reference: 

```
Bank: Redwood Commercial Bank
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Account: ****9900
Routing/ABA: 101000111
SWIFT/BIC: RDBWUSXX
Reference/Memo: INV-6001
Amount: USD 60,000.00
```

tom_support: Sent to customer at 14:05 PT and asked them to reply here with bank confirmation when they initiate. Included invoice link: https://invoices.redwood.ai/INV-6001

claire_finance: Scheduling one automatic card retry in 24h in case they update payment info. If wire confirmation arrives before retry, I'll cancel it.

payments-bot: Scheduled retry set for 1748287522 (24h).

mark_accounting: When wire posts please paste bank confirmation (txn id, amount, posted date) here and I'll apply payment. If partial payment arrives, AM must approve application.

jen_sales: I'll follow up with AM and CC accounting on their payment confirmation. Keeping thread open until cleared. :thumbsup:
